description_expanded: Overview5.0(5 reviews)SEACREST – Sandy Knickers Private Pool | Sleeps 16 DESCRIPTION Welcome to Sandy Knickers, a magnificent three-story home in Seacrest Beach, located south of 30A between Alys Beach and Watersound. This stunning property offers panoramic Gulf views, a private pool, and deeded beach access just steps away. With spacious living areas, luxurious bedrooms, and an unbeatable location, Sandy Knickers is the perfect spot for your family beach getaway. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Step outside to the expansive balcony, the perfect spot to take in breathtaking sunsets or keep an eye on the kids as they swim in the private pool. Just a short stroll away, the deeded beach access invites you to sink your toes into the beautiful white sands and enjoy the emerald waters of the Gulf. HOME FEATURES 4 Bedrooms | 4 Bathrooms | Sleeps 16 Stunning 3rd Floor King Suite: Experience ultimate luxury in the master suite, featuring a brand new bathroom and breathtaking Gulf views. Wake up to the sound of waves and step out onto the balcony to start your day in paradise. First Floor King Suites: Two spacious king-size bedrooms, each with a private ensuite bath, offering comfort and privacy. Double Queen Bunk Room with Queen Trundle: Located on the second floor, this room is perfect for kids or large groups, providing flexible sleeping arrangements. Fully Equipped Kitchen: Cook with ease and gather around the dining table with seating for six or at the beautiful marble peninsula with seating for six more. Coffee & Cocktails: A dedicated coffee station and ice maker at the wet bar make morning brews and evening drinks effortless. Private Pool & Outdoor Spaces: Take a dip in the sparkling private pool (heating available for an additional fee) or unwind in one of the many outdoor areas designed for relaxation. Three Bikes Included: Explore Seacrest Beach and the surrounding areas on the three provided bikes, perfect for cruising to local shops and dining. DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Nearby Attractions: Walk or bike to dining and boutique shopping in Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Watersound. Local Favorites: Enjoy food, drinks, and live music at The Big Chill, just minutes away. Outdoor Adventures: Discover local trails, watersports, and more, all just a short ride away. WHY STAY HERE? Spacious & Luxurious: Ideal for large families or groups seeking a comfortable, modern beach retreat. Gulf Views & Private Pool: Unwind with incredible vistas and a refreshing dip right at home. Perfect Location: Steps from the beach with deeded access. Pet-Friendly: We welcome your fur baby with prior approval and a pet fee, so your whole family can enjoy the beach vacation. Included Amenities: Private pool, three bikes, and proximity to the best of 30A. Book your stay at Sandy Knickers and experience the perfect blend of luxury, relaxation, and beachside fun!Show less
